description.en: Premium anesthesia mask for safe and comfortable ventilation during anesthesia. Transparent dome allows continuous monitoring while soft cushion ensures secure seal.
description.zh: 优质麻醉面罩，专为麻醉期间安全舒适的通气设计。透明穹顶可连续观察，柔软气垫确保可靠密封。
description.id: Masker anestesi premium untuk ventilasi yang aman dan nyaman. Kubah transparan memungkinkan pemantauan berkelanjutan.

description.en: High-quality oxygen mask for effective oxygen delivery. Adjustable nose clip for custom fit. Suitable for adult and pediatric patients.
description.zh: 高品质氧气面罩，有效供氧。可调节鼻夹确保贴合。适用于成人和儿童。
description.id: Masker oksigen berkualitas untuk pengiriman oksigen efektif. Klip hidung dapat disetel. Cocok untuk dewasa dan anak.

description.en: Comfortable nasal cannula for supplemental oxygen. Soft prongs ensure patient comfort during extended use.
description.zh: 舒适的鼻氧管，用于补充供氧。柔软鼻塞确保长时间使用舒适。
description.id: Kanula hidung nyaman untuk oksigen tambahan. Prong lembut memastikan kenyamanan penggunaan jangka panjang.

description.en: Professional anesthesia breathing circuit for reliable gas delivery. Standard 22mm connectors compatible with most anesthesia machines.
description.zh: 专业麻醉呼吸回路，可靠输送气体。标准22mm接口兼容大多数麻醉机。
description.id: Sirkuit napas anestesi profesional untuk pengiriman gas andal. Konektor 22mm kompatibel dengan sebagian besar mesin anestesi.

description.en: High-quality endotracheal tube with HVLP cuff for effective airway management. Clear depth markings facilitate accurate placement.
description.zh: 高品质气管插管，配备高容量低压气囊。清晰深度标记便于准确定位。
description.id: Tabung endotrakeal berkualitas dengan cuff HVLP untuk manajemen jalan napas efektif.

description.en: Premium 100% silicone Foley catheter for comfortable urinary drainage. Radiopaque line enables X-ray verification of placement.
description.zh: 优质100%硅胶Foley导管，舒适引流。显影线可通过X射线确认位置。
description.id: Kateter Foley premium 100% silikon untuk drainase urin yang nyaman.

description.en: High-quality disposable surgical gown from SMS non-woven fabric. Effective barrier protection during procedures. Lightweight and durable.
description.zh: 高品质一次性手术衣，SMS无纺布制成。有效屏障保护，轻便耐用。
description.id: Gaun bedah sekali pakai berkualitas dari kain non-woven SMS. Perlindungan penghalang efektif.

description.en: High-quality nebulizer mask for effective aerosol therapy. Fine particle delivery ensures deep lung deposition. Soft mask for extended treatment.
description.zh: 高品质雾化面罩，有效进行雾化治疗。细雾化颗粒确保深部肺部沉积。
description.id: Masker nebulizer berkualitas untuk terapi aerosol yang efektif.

description.en: Premium silicone anesthesia mask for reusable applications. Autoclavable at 134°C for repeated sterilization.
description.zh: 优质硅胶麻醉面罩，可重复使用。可134°C高温高压灭菌。
description.id: Masker anestesi silikon premium untuk penggunaan berulang.

description.en: Guedel airway for maintaining open airway in unconscious patients. Color-coded for easy size identification.
description.zh: 口咽通气道，用于维持无意识患者气道通畅。颜色编码便于快速选择尺寸。
description.id: Jalan napas Guedel untuk mempertahankan jalan napas terbuka.

description.en: Laryngeal mask airway for effective airway management during anesthesia and emergency.
description.zh: 喉罩通气道，用于麻醉和急救时的有效气道管理。
description.id: Masker laring untuk manajemen jalan napas efektif.

description.en: Manual resuscitator (Ambu bag) for emergency ventilation. Self-reinflating bag with non-rebreathing valve.
description.zh: 简易呼吸器（复苏球囊），用于紧急通气。自动充气球囊配合单向阀。
description.id: Resusitator manual untuk ventilasi darurat.

description.en: Tracheostomy tube for long-term airway management. Cuffed and uncuffed versions available.
description.zh: 气管切开插管，用于长期气道管理。可选带气囊/无气囊版本。
description.id: Tabung trakeostomi untuk manajemen jalan napas jangka panjang.

description.en: Disposable isolation gown for medical and laboratory use. PP, PP+PE, and SMS materials available.
description.zh: 一次性隔离衣，适用于医疗和实验室环境。可选PP、PP+PE、SMS材质。
description.id: Gaun isolasi sekali pakai untuk penggunaan medis dan laboratorium.

description.en: Oxygen mask with reservoir bag for high-concentration oxygen therapy. Suitable for patients requiring higher FiO2.
description.zh: 带储氧袋的氧气面罩，用于高浓度氧疗。适用于需要较高吸入氧浓度的患者。
description.id: Masker oksigen dengan kantung reservoir untuk terapi oksigen konsentrasi tinggi.

value.zh: T型口含器/135°口含器/波纹管

description.en: Complete nebulizer kit for aerosol therapy. Customizable components to meet different clinical needs.

description.id: Kit nebulizer lengkap untuk terapi aerosol. Komponen dapat disesuaikan.

description.en: Venturi mask with 7-color adjustable oxygen concentration for precise FiO2 delivery. Ideal for COPD and chronic respiratory patients.
description.zh: 文丘里面罩，7色可调氧浓度，精确控制吸入氧浓度。适用于慢阻肺和慢性呼吸疾病患者。
description.id: Masker Venturi dengan 7 warna konsentrasi oksigen untuk pengiriman FiO2 presisi.

value.zh: 长接头/短接头/喇叭接头

description.en: Connecting tube with Yankauer handle for effective oral suction. Multiple configurations available.

description.id: Tabung konektor dengan handle Yankauer untuk suction oral yang efektif.

description.en: Suction catheter for respiratory tract suctioning. Color-coded connectors for easy size identification.
description.zh: 吸痰管用于呼吸道吸引。色码接头便于识别尺寸。
description.id: Kateter suction untuk penghisapan saluran pernapasan. Konektor kode warna.

description.en: Latex Foley catheter with silicone coating for smooth insertion. Two-way design for drainage and balloon inflation.

description.id: Kateter Foley lateks dengan lapisan silikon.

description.en: Urine drainage bag for patient urine collection. Non-toxic, non-pyrogenic, single-use.
description.zh: 尿袋用于收集患者尿液。无毒、无热原、一次性使用。
description.id: Kantung urin untuk pengumpulan urin pasien.
